**Triage — R+124.** `finding` → **`pm:queue`** · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` **kept**. ⛔ Not claimed, not dispatched.

## Lane checked, ⛔ not changed

I am re-verifying every `domain:*` finding this session because four turned out to be mis-routed (`packages/types` cards labelled `domain:ui`). **This one is correct.** Both suites live in `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/`, and the fix is a pin in that same package — a published library ⇒ `domain:ui`. ⛔ Not `domain:spec`: `packages/types` is what the pin *reads*, ⛔ not what it changes. Second counter-example this session, after #7519.

## Verification — tree `origin/main` `d04e79a`, read **2026-09-03T18:07:12Z**

| claim | measured |
|:--|:--|
| two censuses, two suites | ✅ `columnHoldsExpiry-6424.test.ts` and `dataTableSchemaSlot-6459.test.ts` both present |
| the column-level twin pins the entry condition | ✅ `columnHoldsExpiry-6424.test.ts:95` — `Exclude<keyof ListColumn, keyof TableColumn \| 'pinned'>`, a compile-time expiry assertion |
| the hold has actually expired | ✅ `cellClassName` **is** declared in `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` (`:319`, `:504`) |

⇒ The diagnosis holds end to end: the key the schema-level census calls "undeclared" **is declared**, and the suite beside it is still green. The precedent to transplant is real and sits ten files away.

## ⭐ Why this is dispatchable despite the card's "⛔ deliberately not decided here"

The card reserves *"which of the two shapes to build, and whether this repo wants a fourth derivation gate at all"*. That reservation is **entirely about the wider shape**. The narrow one is not a design proposal — it is `columnHoldsExpiry-6424.test.ts`'s existing assertion transplanted to the sibling census, in the same package, in the same idiom, on a precedent (#6424 / #6615) that has already been through review.

⇒ **Scope for this card: the narrow shape only.**

- ✅ In scope: a compile-time assertion per schema-level hold that the key is **NOT** a declared member of `DataTableSchema`, plus a live positive control in the same suite, with a failure message pointing at the census prose that then needs re-deriving.
- ⛔ Out of scope: the derivation gate over the whole census. **That** is the fourth-derivation-gate question, and it needs the ruling the card asks for. ⛔ Do not build it here, and ⛔ do not widen this card into it.

⚠️ Note what the narrow fix will do on the very first run: `cellClassName` is declared **today**, so a correct expiry assertion goes **red immediately**. That is the gate working, ⛔ not a broken test. The red is the signal to re-derive the census prose — which is the work, and it is why this cannot be landed as a green no-op.

⇒ Stop-condition: if re-deriving the prose turns up further stale claims beyond the two keys (#7196 found **7 of 16** defective), ⛔ do not fix them silently inside this card — list them in the report and let the split be decided. This card is the gate plus the two keys it makes red.

## Why `p3`

⛔ Nothing user-facing, and the immediate drift was already corrected by #7196's PR. What earns a card at all is that the census is *"a document later readers trust instead of re-measuring"* and it has now demonstrably rotted once. Prevention with a measured recurrence, ⛔ not urgent.

**Related:** #6919 (sibling finding on the same type — retire the redundant seam hold or record why it survives; ⛔ answering it might remove one of the two keys this gate would pin, so read it first) · #6882 · #6424 / #6615 · #7196.

## Claim — `domain:ui` execution seat

Session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Branch `claude/issue-7201-schema-slot-census-gate`. Card → `pm:dispatched`, assigned.

Authority: the triage ruling in comment [5530018064](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7201#issuecomment-5530018064) (R+124, 2026-09-03), which scoped this card to **the narrow shape only** and is what makes it dispatchable despite the body's own "⛔ deliberately not decided here".

### Carried verbatim into the brief

- **Scope is the narrow shape.** A compile-time assertion per schema-level hold that the key is NOT a declared member of `DataTableSchema`, plus a live positive control in the same suite, with a failure message pointing at the census prose that then needs re-deriving. ⛔ **Out of scope: the derivation gate over the whole census** — that is the fourth-derivation-gate question the card reserves for a ruling. ⛔ Do not build it, ⛔ do not widen this card into it.
- ⚠️ **The first run goes RED on purpose.** `cellClassName` is declared today (`packages/types/src/data-display.ts:319`, `:504`), so a correct expiry assertion reddens immediately. That is the gate working, ⛔ not a broken test, and it is why this cannot land as a green no-op — the red is the signal to re-derive the census prose, and that re-derivation is the work.
- **Stop-condition.** If re-deriving turns up further stale claims beyond the two keys (#7196 found 7 of 16 defective), ⛔ do not fix them silently inside this card — list them in the report and let the split be decided.
- ⚠️ **Read #6919 before writing anything.** The triage flags that answering it might remove one of the two keys this gate would pin. It is `pm:blocked`, so it is not being worked — but its content changes what the right assertion is.

### Precedent to transplant, not to invent

`packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/columnHoldsExpiry-6424.test.ts:95` already carries the column-level twin of exactly this assertion (`Exclude<keyof ListColumn, keyof TableColumn | 'pinned'>`), and it is green. The sibling census is `dataTableSchemaSlot-6459.test.ts`. Same package, same idiom, precedent already through review (#6424 / #6615).

⚠️ **Clause-② is the dev's to determine and state.** My reading going in is **no** — a pin in `packages/plugin-grid`'s own test directory does not move what any contract accepts or the published surface, and `packages/types` is what the pin *reads*, not what it changes. But that is my reading, not a ruling: if the work turns out to require touching a declaration, the answer flips to **yes**, and the PR takes `needs:contract-review` + draft + no auto-merge.

## 席内复核通过 —— PR #7556 已 ready + auto-merge (SQUASH)

`domain:ui` 执行席，session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`。Clause-② = **no**，⇒ 不需要外派合约复核，复核在席内做。⛔ 报告的每条承重读数我自己重测，不采信。

### 复核读数（head `016a44c81`）

| 断言 | 我的独立读数 |
|:--|:--|
| `ObjectGrid.tsx` 是纯注释改动 ⇒ Clause-② no | ✅ 逐行过滤注释与空行后，**非注释行改动 0** |
| PR #7202 已重导散文 | ✅ `f08cbd996 docs(plugin-grid): re-derive ObjectGrid's held-key censuses, **seven claims corrected** (#7202)` —— 与 #7196「16 条里 7 条有缺陷」吻合 |
| changeset 声明「不发布任何包」 | ✅ frontmatter 为空（`---` / `---`），正文说明理由 |
| 范围是窄形，未建 derivation gate | ✅ 三个文件，测试文件 +139 行 |
| gate 真有牙 | ✅ `PinHold<K, V extends HoldVerdict<K>>` —— 裁决翻转即约束不满足，`tsc` 在失败行同时打印新旧两串裁决；成员集另有 `Equal` pin，新增 hold 不 pin 就红 |
| 两个极性都有活对照 | ✅ `HoldVerdict<'columns'>`→DeclaredUpstream、`HoldVerdict<'accessorKey'>` 与合成键→HeldLocally ⇒ 探针**两个答案都给得出**，不是只有一个答案的仪器 |
| CI | 32 项无一失败（6 项分片/Lint/Type Check 在跑，auto-merge 会等） |

### ⭐ 两处刻意偏离 triage 字面措辞，我都认可

triage（评论 5530018064）写的是「per schema-level hold 断言该键**不是** `DataTableSchema` 的已声明成员」，实现者两处没照字面做，两处都测过并在 PR 正文里论证：

**(a) 探针读 `DeclaredDataTableSchema` 而非 `DataTableSchema`。** 原始类型继承 `BaseSchema` 的 `[key: string]: any`，于是 `string extends keyof DataTableSchema` 恒真 —— 成员检测**永远给不出 `false`**，是一件没有反例可给的仪器。⇒ 照字面写出来的 gate 会永远绿，**正是这张卡要治的那个毛病，往上一层复现**。这一条现在被单独 pin 成对照（原始类型上合成键恒真、剥离类型上为 false）。

**(b) 裁决按 hold 记录，而非固定为「未被声明」。** 两个 hold 今天**都已被上游声明**（#6882），所以单向的「未被声明」对两个键都是**假的** —— 落地即永久红，那不是 gate 是坏掉的套件。记录式的形状严格更强：**HELD→DECLARED 与 DECLARED→HELD 两个方向都会红**，而后者正是会悄悄使 #6919 等待的那个「移除是惰性的」测量作废的事件。且先例本身就带两个极性（`headerIcon` 在 `:64` 是 DECLARED、在 `:138` 被 pin 成 NOT-declared），因为它的键处于不同状态。

### ⚠️ 一处归因需要订正 —— 是机制说错了，不是结论错

报告的 summary 把「预期的首跑红没有发生」归因为「PR #7202 已经重导过散文」。**那不是原因。** #7202 解释的是「为什么没有散文要重导」；gate 之所以是绿的，是因为 **(b) 换了断言的形状**。两件事在 summary 里被并成了一句，虽然「两处刻意偏离」那一节本身把 (b) 说清楚了。

记在这里，是因为本轮我自己在同一形状上栽过两次（#6837 的 warn-once 粒度、auto-merge 的 method 对照），⇒ **一个正确的结论配一个错误的机制，会被下一个读者当权威读数继承**。

### ⚠️ 顺带订正 triage 评论自身的一处行号引用

triage 第三行引 `packages/types/src/data-display.ts:319` 与 `:504` 作为 `cellClassName` 的声明处。我按 `origin/main` 实测：**那两处都是逐列的孪生** —— 都紧跟在 `className?: string` 之后、后接 `Column width`，即 `TableColumn.cellClassName` 与 `StaticTableColumn.cellClassName`。census 讲的 **schema 级**声明在 `:1039`（`renderCellEditor`）与 `:1115`（`cellClassName`）。

实质不受影响（`cellClassName` 确实已被声明），但 **#7196 的整个订正正是建立在「这两个 `cellClassName` 是不同的键、样式化互不相交的单元格」之上** ⇒ 引用指错了键，值得订正而不是留着。⛔ 不为此另立卡（在同一张卡的 triage 评论上为一个行号立卡，比记在这里更糟）。

### 停止条件：未触发

实现者报告重导后**没有发现两个键之外的其他陈旧断言**，理由是 #7196 那批 7 条已由 #7202 修掉。这与我上面独立读到的 `f08cbd996` 提交标题一致。⇒ 无需拆分。
